$20$Hoo, that didn't work too well!
$10$
$20$Follow me and I'll explain
$20$a few commands...
$70$

slots.original_text: $LOCK$$70$First things first... how to use the camera.

$LOCK$$VIEW$$35$PSSST. I am right behind you.
$67$Just use the $B_CAM_LEFT$ and $B_CAM_RIGHT$ buttons to move the camera...

$LOCK$$VIEW$$23$Now I'll hide up here.
$15$If you wanna find me
$36$keep the $B_INTVIEW$ button pressed down.

$LOCK$$24$Nice goin', bub.
$15$These commands will come in handy
$37$If you wanna look around...

$20$If you wanna follow me
$15$--and who wouldn't--
$18$use the $B_JUMP$ button
$30$and just do what I'm doing!

$22$If you wanna jump higher,
$21$press the button a second time
$25$when you are at the highest point of your jump.
$30$Works like a charm!

$36$Heh-heh, might I also suggest
$18$you use the $B_JUMP$ button
$25$to take a flying leap.

$25$Hey, how'bout a little race?
$14$Ya wanna know how to win:
$21$When you cross the starting line,
$31$you'll get a limited amount of time to finish the race.
$37$To do this, press $C_RED$steadily$C_DEFAULT$ on the $B_RUN$ button
$20$to increase your $C_RED$speed$C_DEFAULT$.
$17$If you run $C_RED$fast enough$C_DEFAULT$,
$30$you'll be able to stay suspended in midair
$24$for a short period of time.
$35$This will come in handy to get over $C_RED$precipices$C_DEFAULT$.
$22$Fancy word for cliffs.

$21$I knew you could do it!
$20$You'll probably be able to challenge
$20$Road Runner later in the game,
$30$if you're up for it!

$35$To help you $C_RED$steal sheep$C_DEFAULT$ from Sam Sheep-Dog,
$25$you will be given several objects.
$19$But wait, there is more.
$24$you also gotta know how to use objects
$13$in the background.
$37$To open the gate, the red button has to be pressed.
$26$Just $C_RED$jump on the first seesaw$C_DEFAULT$
$33$and the big rock will throw you to the other side.
$27$Then $C_RED$jump on the second seesaw$C_DEFAULT$
$30$to launch the little rock towards the button
$29$so that the gate remains open.
$25$Confused yet? Me too...
$35$Woo-hoo! Woo-hoo!

$42$Listen, if you wanna get sheep and make a plan,
$32$you have to use your $C_RED$inventory$C_DEFAULT$.
$26$First press the $B_SELECT$ button
$18$which will show you the level's $C_RED$map$C_DEFAULT$
$24$and the $C_RED$objects$C_DEFAULT$ available to you.
$24$To get an object, you have to order it
$21$by opening a letterbox.
$21$If you want to know in which letterbox
$23$you have to order a specific object,
$20$select it in your inventory 
$35$and a red circle will appear around the letter box,
$23$which means it's yours.
$19$The objects drawn in white
$26$are the ones you can find in the level. 
$19$The colored objects
$33$are those you already collected and can use.
$17$If that's not enough,
$29$you can also look at the objects' user guide
$23$for instructions on how to use it.
$30$So, c'mon -- try out your inventory
$26$and order an object from a letterbox.
$30$Today! Batteries not included.

$30$Hey, what's the matter with you?
$38$pick up that object and store it in your inventory.
$19$Then you can use it right away
$37$by keeping $B_QUICKINV$ pressed down.
$13$Here's another thing --
$28$a menu will appear with your objects.
$19$Just select the one you want
$18$with the right and left directional buttons,
$36$then release the button, and it's done!
$21$If you want to store your object,
$28$Just press once on this button.
$28$Now get back and use the rocket
$22$to fly to the GOAL.

$22$He-he-hey, good for you!
$29$Don't forget that to finish each level,
$34$you must be in the GOAL with the sheep!
$29$In fact, you have to both be in the GOAL
$25$or the challenge doesn't count.
$40$And that would be despicable.
